notes.title: Delete Save Games and Cache
notes.content: Please ensure if you a downloading the demo again (so already on your Steam account, please delete all your previous Save Games and Cache as this may conflict with the new game version.

notes.title: Demo is Back!
notes.content:
Demo is Back!

After a short time offline due to a major reworking of the Demo, I am so pleased to be able to present it back to you in a whole new form with updated locations, visual improvements and mechanics, plus stability visuals and optimisation.

Still a lot needed to be done with the Zombies and AI but it's a journey i'm on.

notes.title: Demo Offline
notes.content: I have removed the demo, temporarily as I progress with a very big update to it, from visuals, game-play, animation and sequences, it's going through a slight overhaul right now.

notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:

notes.content:
